_meta.rule: Cross-department proximity is REAL but narrow. These entries are only offered when they fall inside sister_proximity_km of a local fiche — 30 km, which in this terrain is roughly 40 minutes. At 60 km the pair count explodes to four figures and 'nearby' stops meaning anything on an alpine road. Cards from this file must stay visibly marked as the sibling site: they are a genuine same-publisher cross-link, not local content.
